## Context / Problem
The eval harnesses must work for a client project supplying its own criteria and corpus, by the mechanism rebar uses for its own evals (ruling 2026-09-06). Today `plan_replay/__main__.py:20-21` hard-codes `_DEFAULT_CACHE_DIR`/`_DEFAULT_OUT_DIR` as CWD-relative `docs/experiments/plan-review-gate/replay[/cache]`, and `ledger.py:43` `DEFAULT_LEDGER_PATH` is a `str` default on 5 functions (`:89,153,185,222,244`), re-exported into `tier1.py:390` and `tier2.py:558,681`, with no `--ledger` flag — so a client writes into its own `docs/experiments/`. `provider_parity.py:153-156` globs only packaged specs, so a client's `.rebar/evals/*.eval.yaml` never run. `ledger.py:120` imports `genai_prices` bare although `evals` is a pyproject extra (`:165-167`) missing from `_optional.py::EXTRAS` (`:35-68`). Retiring `"ticket-quality"` from `AGENTIC_SOLVERS` (`provider_parity.py:88`) belongs to the LLM-leftovers epic (winded-chunky-sheldrake). Cites verified on 6a0e3c9afcd.

## Approach
One resolution rule: `[llm.evals] corpus_root`, read from the reserved `llm` table like `[llm.model_classes]` via `config_readers._read_llm_file_table` (`:37-63`), precedence CLI (`rebar -c llm.evals.corpus_root=`) > env (`REBAR_LLM_EVALS_CORPUS_ROOT`) > file > default `.rebar/evals`, as `_llm_str_source` (`:66-84`). Relative values resolve against the repo root; sub-paths are fixed: `<corpus_root>/plan-review-gate/replay/{cache/, ledger.jsonl, tier2-sample.json}`. This repo pins `corpus_root = "docs/experiments"` in `rebar.toml` (a sibling story flips it later), so every current literal is reproduced byte-for-byte: zero behaviour change. `corpus_root` governs replay/ledger OUTPUT paths only. The reserved `llm` table, not a core `_config_schema.py` section, keeps this epic out of the config epic's files; the only new mechanism is the env var, as the ratchet censuses core `_SECTIONS` only (`scripts/_mechanism_delta/detect_config.py:18-22,37`).
- `config_readers.py`: add `DEFAULT_EVALS_CORPUS_ROOT = ".rebar/evals"` and `evals_corpus_root(repo_root=None) -> Path`, resolving the `[llm.evals]` file table against `cli_overrides_for("llm")` and the env var through `_llm_str`, returned unchanged when absolute else resolved under `_root_config.repo_root(repo_root)`; the site carries `# mechanism-ok: env_var REBAR_LLM_EVALS_CORPUS_ROOT — client corpus override`. Add `replay_dir()` (`<root>/plan-review-gate/replay`) and `default_ledger_path()` (`replay_dir()/"ledger.jsonl"`), both taking `repo_root=None`; re-export all three from `rebar.llm.config`. The CLI form works because `parse_cli_overrides` (`config.py:219`) splits only on the FIRST dot (`:233`), leaving `evals.corpus_root` a sub-key under `llm` for `cli_overrides_for("llm")` (`:603`).
- `__main__.py`: delete `:20-21`; the `--cache-dir`/`--out-dir`/`--sample-path` defaults (`:54-55,72-73,86,96-97`) become `None`, resolved at dispatch to `replay_dir()/"cache"`, `replay_dir()`, `replay_dir()/"tier2-sample.json"`; add `--ledger` (`None` → `default_ledger_path()`) threaded into `tier1.run`/`tier2.run_*`.
- `ledger.py`: delete `DEFAULT_LEDGER_PATH`; the 5 `ledger_path: str = DEFAULT_LEDGER_PATH` defaults become `str | None = None` with `ledger_path = ledger_path or default_ledger_path()` first; `tier1.py:390` and `tier2.py:558,681` likewise. `ledger.py:120` becomes `genai_prices = guard_import("genai_prices", extra="evals")`.
- `_optional.py` `EXTRAS`: add `"evals": ("genai_prices", "the plan-review replay ledger's spend accounting (python -m rebar.llm.evals.plan_replay)")`. The shared-probe precedent is the `pricing` Capability (`_capabilities.py:139`), already probing `genai_prices`. A new EXTRAS key has one CI consumer: `test_ci_workflow_parity.py:923,950` requires every key in the `optional-extras` venv loop, so `.github/workflows/_optionality.yml:272-282` gains an `"evals:evals"` entry in `specs`. `pyproject.toml:165` already declares the extra, so `test_packaging_dependencies.py:110` needs no change; the frozen `ci_workflow_parity/c57057f41/` fixture holds other workflows, untouched.
- `provider_parity.py`: `_spec_paths()` (`:153`) gains a `repo_root: str | None = None` parameter and unions the packaged `eval_specs/*.eval.yaml` with `<repo_root>/.rebar/evals/*.eval.yaml` keyed by FILENAME STEM, project file winning — exactly `eval_spec_path` (`eval.py:57-60`), whose `.rebar/evals/<prompt_id>.eval.yaml` beats `_packaged_eval_spec`; stem keying needs no YAML parse at the `list[Path]` boundary. `.rebar/evals` here is deliberate, NOT `corpus_root`: it is the location `load_eval_spec` (`eval.py:71-78`) already reads, so both surfaces resolve a client spec identically. Its SOLE caller `eligible_cases` (`:210`) currently calls `_spec_paths()` with NO argument while already holding a `repo_root` (it passes one to `solver_arm`); that call site MUST become `_spec_paths(repo_root)`, otherwise a client's specs are unioned nowhere on the real run path and the stated problem is unfixed. `AGENTIC_SOLVERS` and `--out` unchanged (see Context).
- `rebar.toml`: add `[llm.evals]` with `corpus_root = "docs/experiments"`. `docs/env-vars.md` regenerated (`_llm_str` is a `KNOWN_ENV_HELPERS` helper, `docs/env-vars.md:8`).

## Scope
`llm/config_readers.py`, `llm/config.py` (re-exports), `llm/evals/plan_replay/{__main__,ledger,tier1,tier2}.py`, `llm/evals/provider_parity.py`, `_optional.py`, `.github/workflows/_optionality.yml` (one `specs` entry), `rebar.toml`, `docs/env-vars.md`, and tests: `evals/test_evals_corpus_root.py` (new), `evals/test_plan_replay_ledger.py`, `test_provider_parity.py`. `test_optional.py` and `test_ci_workflow_parity.py` cover the new entry with no edit. Not touched: `_config_schema.py`/`_config_sources.py`, `eval_solver.py`, `plan_review/fidelity_spot_eval.py`, `evals/fixture_mining/heal.py`, `tests/fixtures/`.

## Testing
`pytest tests/unit/evals tests/unit/test_{optional,ci_workflow_parity,provider_parity}.py -q`, then `make verify` (its `make lint` stage runs the mechanism-delta and env-registry checks).

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] `git grep -n 'docs/experiments' -- src/rebar/llm/evals` returns exactly one line: the path-only docstring cite at `plan_replay/corpus.py:5`. On 6a0e3c9afcd the only other hits are the 3 deleted literals. Asserted by `test_evals_corpus_root.py::test_no_hard_coded_roots`.
- [ ] Default, env, CLI and file precedence for `evals_corpus_root()` are proven by 4 parametrised cases in the new module, plus one asserting an absolute value is returned unchanged.
- [ ] `'evals' in rebar._optional.EXTRAS` is `True`, and with `genai_prices` import blocked `ledger.finalize` raises `OptionalDependencyError` naming `nava-rebar[evals]` (both in `test_plan_replay_ledger.py`).
- [ ] `pytest tests/unit/test_ci_workflow_parity.py -q` is green, proving `_optionality.yml` installs the new extra (`test_optionality_loop_covers_every_declared_extra`) and names a declared one (`test_every_optionality_spec_is_a_declared_extra`).
- [ ] Worked example in `test_provider_parity.py`: a temp repo holding `.rebar/evals/plan-review-novelty.eval.yaml` (stem colliding a packaged spec) and `.rebar/evals/client-only.eval.yaml` yields a `_spec_paths(repo_root)` list whose `plan-review-novelty` entry is the `.rebar/evals` path, containing `client-only` and every non-colliding packaged stem exactly once.
- [ ] That same temp repo drives `eligible_cases(repo_root)`, and the returned `CorpusItem.spec` values include the client-only spec's `prompt` — proving the call site threads `repo_root` so the union is live on the run path, not only in the `_spec_paths` unit test.
- [ ] A parity run with no `--out` writes no file.
- [ ] `AGENTIC_SOLVERS` is byte-identical to main.
- [ ] Replay defaults are path-identical: with the pin, `replay_dir()` and `default_ledger_path()` equal the deleted literals; `test_plan_replay_corpus.py` is unchanged and green.
- [ ] `make verify` exits 0.
